title: NationCraft
description: NationCraft is a server that allows YOU to create your own nations and towns.
body:
NationCraft is not just another survival server—it is a living, breathing canvas of history, politics, and ambition driven entirely by its players. Here, you don't just build a house; you build a legacy. Whether you want to forge a sprawling empire, establish a bustling trade hub, or live as a peaceful diplomat, your choices will actively shape the world around you.

At its heart, NationCraft is about community and geopolitics. Players have the power to draw borders, form complex alliances, write constitutions, and establish unique cultures. Will your nation be a beacon of democracy and open trade, or a highly fortified, isolated stronghold? The destiny of the map is left completely in the hands of the players.

True greatness, however, is rarely achieved alone. To survive and thrive, you will need to collaborate:

Geopolitics & Diplomacy: Sign treaties, establish trade agreements, or manage tense rivalries with neighboring lands.

Economy & Trade: Capitalize on rare resources, open player-run shops, and dominate the server's economy.

Epic Warfare: When words fail, defend your homeland or expand your borders in organized, high-stakes conflicts that will be remembered in the server's history books.

From humble campfires to massive capital cities, every block placed tells a story. Grab your tools, rally your friends, and claim your place in history. Your nation awaits.
